crossRefs.note: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast…
He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

people.line: Sea crossed by Israelites in the Exodus

translations.web: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
translations.bsb: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
translations.kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
